title: APSRTC to Electrify 10,660 Bus Fleet by 2029 under SEMP 4.0 & Introduces 'Dry Lease' Model
summary: First Indian state transport corporation to introduce a 'Dry Lease' model for 1,450 electric buses.

blocks.content: First Indian state transport corporation to introduce a 'Dry Lease' model for 1,450 electric buses.

items: Electrification Mandate: APSRTC electrifying entire 10,660 bus fleet by 2029 under AP Sustainable Electric Mobility Policy 4.0.
PM eBus Sewa Sanction: Centre sanctioned 1,050 electric buses (₹145.3 crore grant, CESL GCC model across 11 cities).
Dry Lease Innovation: APSRTC introducing India's 1st 'Dry Lease' model for 1,450 electric buses to utilize surplus drivers.

blocks.content: PM eBus Sewa central sanction (1,050 buses) vs APSRTC dry lease procurement (1,450 buses).
